detectionPattern: Rendering user-controlled HTML without sanitization or encoding
fixRecipe: Retrieve user-controlled content from backend as plain text
Apply sanitization or filtering if rich text is allowed
Render with React text interpolation instead of raw HTML
constraints: If rich formatting is required, allow-list only bold/italic/links
Do not trust client sanitization alone
patchNotes: Never pass raw HTML to dangerouslySetInnerHTML unless fully sanitized
Prefer plain text rendering for user comments
